cards.title: Why the admin page can look stuck
items: The action writes PROCESSING before waiting for storage and Gemini synchronously.
On a returned error, the client displays the error but does not refresh its server-rendered row. The displayed value may be stale.
Success revalidates the submissions routes and the client calls router.refresh.
Reload once. FAILED or REVIEW_REQUIRED means stale UI. If still PROCESSING, recovery may have failed or execution stopped before it.

cards.title: Scalability and edge cases
items: The admin retry waits on Gemini in the request; 2.6 minutes is consistent with the inline provider call. No explicit timeout or stale-processing watchdog is visible.
Student uploads normally try BullMQ and use synchronous fallback when queueEvaluation returns null; the admin retry bypasses BullMQ.
Queue insertion happens before its database upsert. If Redis accepted the job but the upsert fails, the caller may fall back to inline evaluation while the queued job still exists.
The worker route has no visible auth guard for its GET start and DELETE stop controls.

cards.title: Hydration warning is separate
items: The app's body does not render cz-shortcut-listen. The browser-only attribute is consistent with an extension mutating the DOM; test in a private window with extensions disabled.
This warning does not explain the database submission status.
